integrity: The proof converts membership to a perimeter-excess inequality, resolves the four side and four corner chambers into two ellipse families, derives their common transition, and integrates the exterior pieces exactly. A standalone verifier reconstructs convex hull perimeters and independently checks the area by radial numerical integration; finite checks are not used as the continuum proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats the isotropic planar separation body of the square only, not arbitrary polygons. The parameter uses Schneider's mean-width normalization. The stochastic application is an explicit lower benchmark, not an exact random-cell expectation. Unindexed older computations remain a residual originality risk.
title: Exact area profile of the square separation body
